verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Greptile can be deployed in your own infrastructure with Docker Compose for up to 100 developers or Kubernetes for 100+, on AWS, GCP, Azure or air-gapped environments, with custom or self-hosted LLMs. The security page adds VPC hosting and logs kept only on customer servers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and clarity on licensing or plan availability for self-hosting.
